FINDINGS
AR1168-R10-S01-001

type: test

severity: blocker

title: AC1’s production-shape provenance is asserted by a self-certifying unit test

evidence: AC1 requires a receipt-bound source derived from an already naturally observed modal and explicitly says that a synthetic fixture alone is insufficient. Its declared producer-emission, however, is proved only by running state-light-turn.test.ts. That test can validate the checked-in fixture’s shape, but it cannot establish that the referenced source capture exists, was naturally observed, belongs to the cited occurrence, or contains the normalized facts copied into the fixture. The Issue does not identify the authoritative receipt schema, storage location, resolver, or comparison procedure.

recommendation: Define the smallest observable provenance contract:

exact registered receipt schema and authoritative location;

immutable capture identity and source-local occurrence fields;

a verifier that resolves that receipt and compares its normalized facts with the repository fixture;

a blocked result when the receipt is absent, unreadable, mismatched, or synthetic-only.
Keep the Vitest command as behavioral fixture validation, not as proof of external provenance.

persistent-machinery: no

simplification-cut-candidate: yes

economics:

one-time-cost: low

ongoing-cost: negligible

avoided-cost: prevents implementation and review rounds built on an unverifiable prerequisite

cut: remove the implication that a repository unit test proves natural-observation provenance

AR1168-R10-S01-002

type: spec

severity: major

title: The supposedly closed accessibility observation surface contains an open-ended predicate

evidence: The signature rejects a non-empty aria-owns value or “any other observed external ownership edge.” No closed list defines those other edges, the browser API that reports them, their cardinality, or their fixture representation. At the same time, role and accessible-name decisions depend on “browser-driver” semantics. The current runtime dynamically loads whichever Playwright installation is found among several locations rather than binding this behavior to one declared implementation/version. Thus, the five-condition signature is not fully deterministic at the production boundary.

recommendation: For signature v1, cut the open-ended clause and reject exactly the production-proven aria-owns condition. Add another external ownership mechanism only after naming its precise observable, API, fixture field, and negative tests. Also bind role/name observation to the exact existing Playwright operation used by the implementation and require fail-closed behavior when that capability is unavailable.

persistent-machinery: no

simplification-cut-candidate: yes

economics:

one-time-cost: low

ongoing-cost: none

avoided-cost: prevents speculative generic accessibility inspection and version-dependent behavior

cut: “or any other observed external ownership edge”

AR1168-R10-S01-003

type: scope-violation

severity: blocker

title: The canonical launcher discards the new no-resend evidence, while the Issue forbids fixing that boundary

evidence: The Issue adds rate_limit_modal and refusal_same_chat objects and states that marker-proved delivery overrides a reported send_count: 0.

The canonical long-running launcher’s parseTurnResult reconstructs a new result from a closed set of existing fields and does not retain either new object. Its delivery derivation then returns not-sent whenever resolved send_count is zero.

Yet the Issue explicitly places flow-manager-long-running-child.ts, its tests, invocation-envelope semantics, and caller retry-classification changes out of scope.

Consequently, r10 specifies marker-over-send-count authority inside the helper but does not preserve that authority through the canonical terminal transport.

recommendation: Choose one coherent boundary:

Preferred forced cut: remove caller-significant resend_effect evidence and express every no-resend result entirely through existing outer state/cause/send-count combinations that the current launcher already preserves; prove the existing retry classifier rejects each combination.

Alternative: expand scope to the canonical launcher parser and focused tests so marker-proved or marker-ambiguous delivery survives parsing and cannot be emitted as not-sent. This would be a substantive revision and must explicitly adjudicate the #1164 boundary.

persistent-machinery: no

simplification-cut-candidate: yes

economics:

one-time-cost: medium

ongoing-cost: low

avoided-cost: prevents contradictory terminal records and future resend-policy divergence

cut: optional evidence whose asserted authority disappears at the canonical consumer boundary

AR1168-R10-S01-004

type: spec

severity: major

title: post_action_unknown and driver_error are not disjoint outcomes

evidence: post_action_unknown includes any case where activation may have been dispatched and its effect cannot be proved, including failure of the mandatory reread. driver_error also includes a driver operation failing after action may have been dispatched. A rejected or timed-out post-click reread therefore satisfies both outcomes. The “exhaustive” mapping assigns the two outcomes different causes without establishing precedence.

recommendation: Make the partition deterministic:

reserve driver_error for failures occurring while activation is definitely unattempted and prompt dispatch is excluded;

classify every error after activation may have dispatched as post_action_unknown;

remove the driver_error after possible action mapping row and its extra cause.

persistent-machinery: no

simplification-cut-candidate: yes

economics:

one-time-cost: low

ongoing-cost: lower than the current design

avoided-cost: eliminates duplicate branches and unstable telemetry expectations

cut: post-action driver_error classification

AR1168-R10-S01-005

type: spec

severity: major

title: The evidence schemas permit contradictory known-value combinations

evidence: The flat RateLimitModalEvidenceV1 structure permits combinations such as:

outcome: dismissed with post_action_read_success: false;

outcome: self_cleared with activation_attempt_count: 1;

a terminal blocking outcome with normal_evaluation_resumed: true;

action_dispatch: uncertain with a positively proven dismissal.

RefusalSameChatEvidenceV1 similarly permits marker cardinality 1, a committed stable reply, and resend_effect: unchanged, although §12 requires that condition to forbid resend. The specification only defines fail-closed handling for unknown fields, schemas, or enum values—not contradictory combinations of valid values.

recommendation: Prefer a forced simplification:

derive normal_evaluation_resumed, post_action_read_success, and resend consequence from the authoritative outcome rather than serializing redundant decisions; or

replace the flat structures with closed discriminated variants and specify a runtime validator plus negative tests for every forbidden combination.

persistent-machinery: no

simplification-cut-candidate: yes

economics:

one-time-cost: medium

ongoing-cost: low

avoided-cost: prevents internally inconsistent evidence from being interpreted differently by helper, tests, and future consumers

cut: redundant independently writable fields derivable from outcome and marker/publication state

M5 forced-cut summary

KEEP

One exact v1 modal signature.

Invocation-owned-tab isolation.

At most one acknowledgement attempt.

Fresh bounded reread as the only clearing proof.

#1172 marker ownership as the sole same-turn authority.

Existing caller-owned retry eligibility.

No service, watcher, registry, account-global state, or generic modal framework.

KEEP WITH REQUIRED CORRECTION

Production-shape fixture, after its external receipt becomes concretely verifiable.

Accessibility-role/name observation, after its exact production API is bound.

Additive evidence, only after it is deterministic and preserved at every claimed authority boundary.

Outer-result mapping, after outcomes are made mutually exclusive.

CUT

Unit-test execution as proof of natural-observation provenance.

The open-ended “other external ownership edge” predicate.

Post-action driver_error as a separate outcome from post_action_unknown.

Redundant evidence fields that permit contradictory combinations.

Caller-significant evidence that the canonical launcher silently discards, unless that launcher is deliberately brought into scope.

M5 status: KEEP WITH REQUIRED CORRECTION

FINDINGS
AR1168-R10-S02-001

type: security

severity: blocker

title: The “closed” control inventory permits unrecognized interactive controls

evidence: Automatic activation rejects only twelve enumerated roles: button, link, menu-item variants, checkbox/radio/switch, tab, option, combobox, and textbox. Other actionable semantics—such as slider, spinbutton, searchbox, listbox, tree controls, or native interactive elements without one of those explicit roles—do not invalidate the signature. A changed or foreign dialog can therefore retain the exact heading and Got it button, add another actionable control outside the list, and still satisfy all five predicates. That contradicts the stated guarantee that unknown and operator-decision dialogs receive zero clicks.

recommendation: Replace the partial role blacklist with a production-grounded exact control inventory. The smallest safe contract is to require the runtime modal’s complete visible interactive/focusable descendant inventory to match the registered fixture and to reject any additional or unclassifiable actionable descendant. Do not build a generic classifier.

persistent-machinery: no

simplification-cut-candidate: no

AR1168-R10-S02-002

type: security

severity: blocker

title: Stacked-dialog rejection ignores implicit and accessibility-semantic dialogs

evidence: Condition 5 rejects only visible DOM elements carrying an explicit role="dialog". A native visible <dialog> without that attribute, or another element exposed by the browser accessibility layer as a dialog without an explicit DOM role, is not counted. The Issue nevertheless claims that any second policy, consent, login, payment, or operator-decision dialog makes activation non-actionable. Those statements are not equivalent.

recommendation: Define the page-level stacked-dialog predicate through the same exact browser observation surface used for dialog semantics, including native <dialog> elements. Any unreadable or unclassifiable candidate must fail closed.

persistent-machinery: no

simplification-cut-candidate: no

AR1168-R10-S02-003

type: spec

severity: blocker

title: The production-shape prerequisite has no verifiable producer and contains a dispatch-order contradiction

evidence: Before worker dispatch, the flow-manager must register an immutable capture derived from an already observed production modal. The worker is then expected to materialize the repository fixture from that source. AC1, however, places both source registration and the fixture-recording requirement under “Before worker dispatch,” while its declared proof is only a Vitest command. A unit test over a checked-in JSON fixture cannot prove that the source was naturally observed, immutable, receipt-bound, or traceable to a registered occurrence. The Issue names no authoritative receipt location, schema, identifier format, or command that resolves the fixture identity back to the original capture. This fails the repository’s evidence-feasibility rule requiring an exact producer and observation surface before imposing a blocking evidence requirement.

recommendation: Split the contract into two stages:

Pre-dispatch gate: name the existing authoritative receipt surface and require an exact capture ID, source-local occurrence, digest, and scrub status.

Worker acceptance: materialize the fixture and mechanically verify that its identity and normalized facts correspond to that receipt.

If no such existing receipt surface is available, remove the automated provenance claim and make this an explicit operator-reviewed prerequisite rather than a self-certifying test.

persistent-machinery: no

simplification-cut-candidate: yes

AR1168-R10-S02-004

type: spec

severity: blocker

title: driver_error and post_action_unknown classify the same failure states

evidence: The deadline contract says that once modal activation may have been dispatched, a driver timeout or inconclusive action result must yield post_action_unknown. The closed outcome list also defines driver_error for a driver operation failing after action may have dispatched, and the mapping table contains a driver_error branch where activation may have been attempted. The same event therefore has two valid outcomes and potentially two causes. The supposedly exhaustive mapping is non-deterministic.

recommendation: Make the outcomes disjoint:

Any error, timeout, or lost action result after activation starts or may have started → post_action_unknown.

driver_error → only failures where modal activation and prompt dispatch are both definitely excluded.

Remove the second driver_error mapping row.

persistent-machinery: no

simplification-cut-candidate: yes

AR1168-R10-S02-005

type: spec

severity: major

title: One phase and one outcome cannot represent the required multi-phase modal lifecycle

evidence: The modal is checked after navigation, before terminal composer failure, around obstructed composer operations, and during post-send observation. It may be dismissed in one phase and recur in another. Yet RateLimitModalEvidenceV1 contains only one phase and one outcome, alongside aggregate counters. No precedence rule defines whether phase means first appearance, activation phase, final check, terminal check, or last successful observation. Consequently, dismissal followed by post-send recurrence cannot be serialized unambiguously under the exact wire contract.

recommendation: Keep a single aggregate object, but replace ambiguous phase with deterministic fields such as:

first_seen_phase;

activation_phase;

final_observation_phase;

final_outcome.

Define update and precedence semantics for recurrence. A general event log is unnecessary.

persistent-machinery: no

simplification-cut-candidate: yes

AR1168-R10-S02-006

type: spec

severity: major

title: Required numeric evidence cannot be truthfully emitted after page loss or unreadable driver state

evidence: candidate_dialog_count is a mandatory number, while owned_page_lost and driver_error explicitly cover circumstances where the page or required observation cannot be read. The contract does not say whether the helper should emit zero, a stale last-known count, or another value. Zero would falsely assert absence; a previous count would falsely appear current. Similar ambiguity affects the meaning of the aggregate appearance count after read failure.

recommendation: Make observation-derived counts nullable whenever the corresponding read did not complete. Define each value as either “from the final successful observation” with an explicit freshness field or as current-only with null on failure. Do not encode unknown as zero.

persistent-machinery: no

simplification-cut-candidate: no

AR1168-R10-S02-007

type: spec

severity: major

title: “Any other external accessibility ownership edge” is not a closed observable

evidence: The signature rejects non-empty aria-owns or any other observed external ownership edge, and the production fixture must record whether such an edge exists. No other edge types, browser API, query, or returned field are named. Implementations can therefore disagree about what is observable, and tests can manufacture an interpretation that the live driver path does not supply. This conflicts with r10’s stated aim of closing the production observation surface.

recommendation: For v1, cut the undefined phrase and bind external ownership ambiguity exactly to non-empty aria-owns, unless a second concrete production-visible edge and its exact driver API are named. Future observed edge types can require a signature-version revision as already required for surface expansion.

persistent-machinery: no

simplification-cut-candidate: yes

M5 forced-cut summary

KEEP

One invocation-owned tab and at most one modal activation.

Exact accessible-name normalization.

Mandatory fresh reread before claiming dismissal.

Separation of page-layer dismissal from account refusal.

#1172 marker ownership as the sole same-turn witness.

Existing caller-owned zero-send retry classification.

No manager continuation, cross-tab state, service, registry, retry engine, or cancellation protocol.

KEEP WITH REQUIRED CORRECTION

The production-bound modal signature, after closing control and stacked-dialog detection.

The production fixture prerequisite, after assigning it a real evidence producer and separating pre-dispatch registration from worker materialization.

Additive turn-result/v1 evidence, after defining deterministic multi-phase aggregation and truthful unknown values.

The outer-result mapping, after eliminating the driver_error/post_action_unknown overlap.

CUT

Undefined “other external accessibility ownership edge.”

The second post-possible-action driver_error branch.

The ambiguous single phase interpretation.

M5 status: KEEP WITH REQUIRED CORRECTION
Persistent machinery proposed by this review: none
Review-economics status: proportionate; corrections reduce ambiguity without adding durable runtime or operational machinery.

FINDINGS
AR1168-R10-S03-001

type: spec
severity: blocker
title: Pre-send modal-action uncertainty is incorrectly treated as prompt-delivery uncertainty

evidence: The binding sequence requires the helper to activate the modal acknowledgement and then complete a mandatory fresh read before it may resume the interrupted composer operation. Therefore, a pre-send post_action_unknown caused by failure or timeout during that reread still proves that prompt dispatch has not occurred. Nevertheless, §10 maps post_action_unknown in any phase to observation_uncertain with resend forbidden. The driver_error mapping similarly forbids resend whenever modal activation may have been attempted, even when prompt dispatch remains excluded. This contradicts Goal 10 and §13, which preserve caller-owned retry classification for positively proven pre-send zero-dispatch terminal results. It conflates uncertainty about dismissing a page layer with uncertainty about delivering the user payload.

recommendation: Represent modal-action dispatch and prompt dispatch as separate facts. Split post_action_unknown and post-activation driver_error mappings:

before prompt dispatch, retain the prohibition on a second modal click in the same invocation, but leave retry classification unchanged for the existing caller;

after prompt dispatch, or when prompt dispatch cannot be excluded, retain observation_uncertain and resend prohibition.

A new retry mechanism is unnecessary; the correction should preserve the existing caller classification.

persistent-machinery: no
economics: not applicable — no persistent machinery proposed
simplification-cut-candidate: yes — cut modal-dismissal uncertainty as an independent no-resend authority

AR1168-R10-S03-002

type: test
severity: major
title: The production-shape provenance gate is not independently provable

evidence: The Issue says a synthetic fixture cannot satisfy AC1 and requires a receipt-bound source from a naturally observed modal. However, the only permitted repository artifact is the normalized fixture, while AC1’s producer-emission names orchestrator-pack and gives a Vitest command as its proof. No exact receipt artifact, immutable source location, digest relationship, lookup operation, or validator binding the registered source to the fixture is specified. A unit test reading fields such as “capture identity” and “source-local occurrence” cannot distinguish authentic receipt-derived data from values written directly into a synthetic fixture. The contract therefore claims stronger provenance evidence than its stated observation surface can supply. This conflicts with the evidence-feasibility rule requiring an exact evidence producer and observation surface for a blocking provenance requirement.

recommendation: Bind AC1 to a named existing receipt surface and require a direct pre-dispatch read-back that verifies at least the immutable receipt identity, source occurrence, and fixture digest or normalized facts. Alternatively, explicitly classify source registration as operator/manual prerequisite evidence and limit the Vitest producer assertion to fixture shape and behavioral consumption. Do not add a registry, recorder, or service.

persistent-machinery: no
economics: not applicable — use an existing receipt/read-back surface
simplification-cut-candidate: yes — cut the self-certifying unit-test provenance claim

AR1168-R10-S03-003

type: security
severity: major
title: The supposedly fail-closed negative recognition surface omits real dialogs and controls

evidence: The global stacked-dialog predicate rejects only visible DOM elements with an explicit role="dialog". A visible native <dialog> or another element receiving an implicit accessibility role of dialog is not covered, despite the stated requirement to reject any second stacked, policy, consent, payment, or operator-decision dialog. Similarly, the “closed invalidating control-role set” omits valid interactive roles such as slider, spinbutton, searchbox, listbox, treeitem, and scrollbar. Consequently, an exact heading and Got it button can remain actionable while an additional unlisted control is present. This contradicts the claim that unknown or mixed-control dialog shapes fail closed and that no other operator-decision dialog may coexist. The listed “custom explicit invalidating role” fixture is also undefined relative to the closed enumeration.

recommendation: Replace the partial negative space with one exact helper-local rule:

detect other visible dialogs through the same accessibility-role semantics used for heading and button recognition, including native implicit dialogs; and

reject any additional visible interactive or focusable dialog descendant, with unknown role determination treated as non-actionable.

If a finite role list is retained instead, it must be complete for the supported browser observation API, explicitly versioned, and tested with omitted-role cases such as slider, spinbutton, and native <dialog>.

persistent-machinery: no
economics: not applicable — this is a local recognition predicate
simplification-cut-candidate: yes — replace two incomplete enumerations with one closed fail-closed predicate

AR1168-R10-S03-004

type: spec
severity: major
title: The proposed evidence objects permit contradictory but schema-valid safety states

evidence: The proposed interfaces enumerate field types but define no cross-field validity rules. For example, RefusalSameChatEvidenceV1 permits marker_cardinality: 1, stable_reply: present, output_publication: committed, and resend_effect: unchanged, despite the binding requirement that this state forbid resend. RateLimitModalEvidenceV1 similarly permits outcome: dismissed with zero activation attempts, no confirmed read, and action_dispatch: not_attempted. The text says unknown fields and enum values fail closed, but it does not require fail-closed handling for impossible combinations of known values. In addition, §10 depends on whether prompt dispatch is excluded, while the new object records only modal action_dispatch; the required prompt-delivery fact is absent from the proposed exact evidence shape.

recommendation: Define the two evidence objects as discriminated unions or add an explicit closed invariant table and runtime validator. Any invalid combination must fail closed before normal evaluation or retry classification. Add negative tests for contradictory known-value combinations, not only unknown fields and enums. Prompt-delivery exclusion must remain distinct from modal-action dispatch.

persistent-machinery: no
economics: not applicable — local type and runtime validation only
simplification-cut-candidate: no

M5 forced-cut summary

KEEP: Narrow invocation-local known-modal handling and marker-owned same-chat observation belong in the same Browser-GPT turn state machine; splitting them would duplicate integration around result construction, refusal handling, and no-resend classification.

REQUIRED CUTS:

Cut uncertain modal dismissal as an independent reason to forbid resending a prompt that was provably never dispatched.

Cut self-certifying provenance from AC1; use direct receipt read-back or honestly separate manual provenance from behavioral tests.

Cut the partial dialog/control negative enumerations and replace them with one genuinely closed fail-closed observation rule.

Persistent machinery decision: none justified. No watcher, service, registry, queue, lease, database, recorder, or retry engine is needed.

M5 decision: KEEP WITH REQUIRED CORRECTION

Delegation outcome: not invoked — architectural review reasoning is an explicitly excepted step.

### Author cluster remedies

- **C1 — production-shape provenance:** unit tests no longer claim natural-observation provenance. An authorized operator publishes one closed `issue-1168-production-shape-source/v1` comment; flow-manager reads the exact comment ID, verifies full-body and normalized-shape SHA-256 values, checks the scrub fence, and records the binding before dispatch. Missing/edit/mismatch/synthetic evidence blocks dispatch.
- **C2 — exact production observation surface:** partial role blacklists, explicit-role-only stacked-dialog counting, and the open-ended ownership-edge phrase are removed. Recognition uses the existing `loadChromium` Playwright instance, computed dialog/heading/button roles, exact non-empty `aria-owns` rejection, complete visible descendant inventory, and exact source-bound equality. Any mismatch or unreadability produces zero clicks.
- **C3 — canonical launcher delivery preservation:** `flow-manager-long-running-child.ts` and its focused tests enter scope only for strict optional-evidence parsing and three delivery-precedence rules before the unchanged legacy derivation. Marker-proved delivery becomes `landed`; marker ambiguity or possible prompt dispatch becomes `POSSIBLY_DELIVERED`, including reported `send_count: 0`. #1164 lifecycle semantics remain unchanged.
- **C4 — modal action versus prompt dispatch:** these are separate facts. Every error after modal activation may have dispatched is `post_action_unknown`; driver/page-loss outcomes are pre-action only. Pre-send modal-action uncertainty prohibits another modal click but does not independently ambiguate prompt delivery or change caller retry authority.
- **C5 — closed wire invariants:** flat evidence bags and `resend_effect` are replaced by closed discriminated unions plus helper/launcher runtime validators. Unknown fields/enums and contradictory known-value combinations fail closed.
- **C6 — deterministic multi-phase aggregation:** evidence records `first_seen_phase`, `activation_phase`, `final_observation_phase`, monotonic `appearance_count`, and `final_outcome`. Later recurrence/blocking/uncertainty supersedes earlier clearing; no event log is introduced.
- **C7 — truthful unreadable values:** current-only final-read counts are `null` after unknown/page-lost/unavailable reads; unknown is never encoded as zero.
- **C8 — proportionate scope/economics:** only one operator source comment, one scrubbed fixture, local validators/matcher, and additive launcher parsing/tests are retained. No service, registry, watcher, recorder, event log, generic accessibility framework, retry engine, queue, database, or lifecycle subsystem is added.

# M4 update

## KEEP

- One invocation-owned tab, one modal activation attempt, fresh bounded reread, and invocation-local state.
- Modal clearing remains independent from account refusal.
- The landed #1172 marker-owned user node/publication window remains the sole same-turn delivery authority.
- Marker-proved delivery is canonical `landed`; marker ambiguity or possible prompt dispatch is never canonical `not-sent`.
- Existing caller-owned retry classes, pacing, and stage-completeness semantics remain unchanged.
- Manager continuation remains isolated in #1185.
- #1164 retains receipt, handoff, waiter, finalization, terminal-envelope, recovery, and detached-process lifecycle ownership.
